question.problem:
Find the vector $x$, if $B=\{{b}_{1},{b}_{2}\}$ is a basis of $\text{Span}\{{b}_{1},{b}_{2}\},$ and 

$$
{b}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -5 \\ -3\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -3 \\ -1\end{aligned}],\,[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}6 \\ -7\end{aligned}].
$$
question.worked_solution:
We know that any vector in  $\text{Span}\{{b}_{1},{b}_{2}\}$ has the form

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -5 \\ -3\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -3 \\ -1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

 

where ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$ are the coordinates relative to the basis $\,B.$ Since we are told that $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}6 \\ -7\end{aligned}],$ we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}x & ={{(\,6\,)}_{⏟}}_{{x}_{1}}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -5 \\ -3\end{aligned}]+{{(\,-7\,)}_{⏟}}_{{x}_{2}}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -3 \\ -1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}6 \\ -30 \\ -18\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-14 \\ 21 \\ 7\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-8 \\ -9 \\ -11\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
